# Vendored browser libraries

These files are copied unchanged from the npm packages named below, so the
dev-center runs without loading anything from a CDN. All are MIT-licensed; the
license text of each package is in its `LICENSE` file, reproduced at the end.

| File                 | Package              | Version | Upstream file                              |
|----------------------|----------------------|---------|--------------------------------------------|
| `popper.min.js`      | `@popperjs/core`     | 2.11.8  | `dist/umd/popper.min.js`                   |
| `tippy.umd.min.js`   | `tippy.js`           | 6.3.7   | `dist/tippy-bundle.umd.min.js`             |
| `chart.umd.min.js`   | `chart.js`           | 4.5.1   | `dist/chart.umd.min.js`                    |
| `tagify.js`          | `@yaireo/tagify`     | 4.39.0  | `dist/tagify.js` (UMD)                     |
| `tagify.css`         | `@yaireo/tagify`     | 4.39.0  | `dist/tagify.css`                          |
| `moment.min.js`      | `moment`             | 2.29.1  | `min/moment.min.js`                        |

Tagify 4.39.0 no longer ships `tagify.polyfills.min.js`, so the dev-center does
not load it.
